subject.title: fix(ui): remove stale Saved status from Notifications

question: Should the assigned maintainer accept the product choice that settled Settings autosaves are silent while section-specific readiness indicators remain visible?
rationale: The implementation and proof support the change, but the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human merge decision for this UI behavior.

options.title: Accept quiet settled autosaves
options.body: Merge the focused change so Settings only shows autosave feedback while a write is active or recovery is required.

options.title: Retain persistent confirmation
options.body: Keep the existing success-row behavior if maintainers consider a durable Saved acknowledgement necessary across Settings sections.

recommendation.title: Accept quiet settled autosaves
recommendation.body: Merge the focused change so Settings only shows autosave feedback while a write is active or recovery is required.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete, who authored the focused UI change and supplied the relevant visual and test evidence.
